g.text: Preciazo - Design-Level Event Storming: Community Price Verification
AV2 Design Proposal - US28, US29, TS07
On an anomaly or unavailable screening rule
After a new vote is recorded
Only when a configured decision rule applies
Held reports, evidence, votes and reason
Accept or reject with a reason
TS07: Reject a repeated report by the same buyer
for the same store offer within 60 seconds.
Rejected requests do not create another report event.
Proposed vote rule: one vote per buyer and report.
Duplicate or opposite second votes do not change confidence.
A buyer votes on another buyer's OPEN report.
Define the anomaly threshold, confidence formula,
accept / reject / review thresholds and trust-profile rules.
Until agreed, no numeric default or automatic acceptance is assumed.
A vote does not directly overwrite the catalog price.
Initial screening completes before the report is visible.
Final decisions cannot be reopened in this scope.
